text:
Raj: Heads-up I had to pay an urgent visa expedite fee out-of-pocket this morning to get to a conference. Embassy only accepted card at counter and corpcard wasn't allowed. I have the official receipt and the expedite confirmation email. Should I file as reimbursement or does Travel cover embassy fees?

Tom (Finance): Sorry about that. Embassy/visa fees are reimbursable when theyre work-related. Submit as reimbursement, category = "Travel - Visas & Permits". Attach the receipt + the conference approval email. If you paid in local currency include the bank/card statement showing the conversion.

Raj: Receipt: https://files.redwood.example/receipts/2003006789-visa.pdf Conversion line: attached screenshot of card statement showing GBP -> EUR charge.

Mei (People Ops): Quick policy note  we require prior approval for visa costs whenever possible, but we allow retro approval for last-minute expedite. Tagging your manager will speed approval.

Raj: Tagged manager and uploaded documentation. Submitted EXP-4255. Note in form: "Urgent expedite for conf attendance; manager retro-approved"

ExpenseBot: EXP-4255 received. Status: pending manager approval and finance review. ETA processing: 3 business days.

Tom (Finance): Reviewing now. Two clerical things: 1) in the form choose payment method = "Personal Card"; 2) if you want direct reimbursement to bank choose that option, otherwise payroll will include it next cycle. Also, will we need any further proof of conference attendance?

Raj: Payment method set to Personal Card. I can attach the conference badge + travel itinerary if that helps.

Mei (People Ops): Manager approved. Conference badge attached to thread.

Tom (Finance): Approved. We'll reimburse the exact amount in EUR converted at the bank rate shown on your card statement. No VAT reclaim on embassy fees. Reimbursement scheduled via bank transfer in 5 business days.

Raj: Appreciate it, thanks!

ExpenseBot: EXP-4255 approved by finance and queued for payment.

Tom (Finance): One small ops note for future: Travel team, embassies that disallow corporate cards in-country keep a list? If so let's add to vendor/blocklist so employees know ahead of time. @Mei

Mei (People Ops): Putting a short notice in the travel wiki.

Raj: Closing thread, thanks everyone :)
